quarterly_data.quarter: Huawei press release: Huawei's NG WAN Solution Enters Large-Scale Commercial Use (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Huawei announced at UBBF 2026 the large-scale commercial use of its Next-Generation (NG) WAN Solution, which it says has already been deployed by more than 60 carriers worldwide; Vice President of the Data Communication Product Line John Cai said the widespread deployment marks the full-scale commercialization of NG WAN. Stated capabilities (company claims): router intrusion detection on independent Threat Protection Units (TPUs) that detects over 95% of threats; the PQC algorithm supported on all Huawei devices in all scenarios; for AI computing, the AI Fabric two-layer multi-plane architecture expands network scale fourfold while reducing hardware usage by 30%, network-wide NPLB achieves 98% link utilization and lifts training and inference performance by over 7%, and the Starnet lossless algorithm achieves zero packet loss for transmission over 1,000 km with more than 96% remote computing efficiency.
quarterly_data.figure: NG WAN deployed by more than 60 carriers worldwide
